units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:11">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="D00072"><he>דָּבַק</he></cite>.
Ḥull. 50ᵃ מקום הד׳ the place where the entrails adhere to the hip.—Pl. דְּבָקִים followers.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 824:3">Yalk. Deut. 824</cite> <he>אתם ודִבְקֵיכֶם</he> ye and your followers.

senses.gloss: nexus, cause. Pl. as above; constr. דִּבְקֵי, דִּיבְ׳.—ד׳ מיתה duties the neglect of which is the cause of premature death.
